integrity: The finite optimum is established by two exact maximum-clique searches on a graph reconstructed from the published read-vector definition; the explicit code and the classical comparison are independently checked.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for binary length 7, read length 2, and minimum read-vector Hamming distance 5; no asymptotic claim. An unindexed prior finite computation remains a residual originality risk.
title: The binary \(2\)-read \((7,5)\) optimum is \(8\)
